result.result:
The noon report for MV ASHBY FELL (report nr-0103-0120) has been retrieved, together with the charter party terms for ship SIM-0103. I then ran the consumption check against the CP warranty.

**Result:** check_consumption returned an error — *"the CP gives no warranted consumption."* The charter party terms on file cover ETA notice rules, the good-weather definition, off-hire and war-risks clauses, but they do **not** state a warranted daily VLSFO consumption figure (or a warranted speed/consumption warranty) for this voyage.

Because there is no warranted consumption figure in the CP, I cannot judge the reported 39.0 t VLSFO (and 0.2 t MGO) against a warranty, and I will not invent a benchmark. Nothing needs to be sent to the Master or operator on this basis.

If you have a separate performance warranty (e.g., from a fixture recap or rider clause) that was not in the CP terms file, please provide it and I can re-run the check.
